name: fibo
label: FIBO (Financial Ontology)
description: Financial Industry Business Ontology — EDM Council + OMG standard

table_notes.fibo_legal_entity: Master registry of legal entities identified by GLEIF LEI codes, covering corporations, funds, and branches with jurisdiction and ownership hierarchy.
table_notes.fibo_currency: ISO 4217 currency reference table with minor-unit precision metadata; used as a denomination anchor for instruments and prices.
table_notes.fibo_financial_instrument: Instrument master with ISIN/CUSIP identifiers linking each security to its issuing legal entity, denomination currency, and type-specific attributes.
table_notes.fibo_market: Exchange and trading venue registry keyed by ISO 10383 MIC codes, providing the market context for price observations.
table_notes.fibo_price: High-volume market data table capturing bid, ask, close, and other price types per instrument per market per day, denominated in a stated currency.

fibo_legal_entity.name: id
fibo_legal_entity.description: Internal surrogate key (UUID) for the legal entity

fibo_legal_entity.name: lei
fibo_legal_entity.description: GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier (20-char ISO 17442 alphanumeric code)

fibo_legal_entity.name: legal_name
fibo_legal_entity.description: Official registered legal name of the entity

fibo_legal_entity.name: entity_type
fibo_legal_entity.description: FIBO entity classification (e.g. Corporation, Fund, Branch, SovereignEntity)

fibo_legal_entity.name: jurisdiction
fibo_legal_entity.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the legal jurisdiction of incorporation

fibo_legal_entity.name: status
fibo_legal_entity.description: GLEIF entity status: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, or PENDING_TRANSFER

fibo_legal_entity.name: parent_lei
fibo_legal_entity.description: LEI of the direct parent entity; references fibo_legal_entity.lei for ownership hierarchy

fibo_legal_entity.name: headquarters_address
fibo_legal_entity.description: Structured registered address: {street, city, region, postal_code, country}

fibo_currency.name: iso_code
fibo_currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, JPY)

fibo_currency.name: name
fibo_currency.description: Full English name of the currency (e.g. United States Dollar)

fibo_currency.name: minor_unit
fibo_currency.description: Number of decimal places in the minor unit (ISO 4217 exponent; 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD)

fibo_currency.name: issuing_country
fibo_currency.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the primary issuing country or monetary authority

fibo_financial_instrument.name: id
fibo_financial_instrument.description: Internal surrogate key (UUID) for the instrument

fibo_financial_instrument.name: isin
fibo_financial_instrument.description: ISO 6166 International Securities Identification Number (12-char alphanumeric)

fibo_financial_instrument.name: cusip
fibo_financial_instrument.description: CUSIP 9-character identifier used in North American markets

fibo_financial_instrument.name: instrument_type
fibo_financial_instrument.description: FIBO instrument classification (e.g. CommonStock, GovernmentBond, ETF, OTCDerivative)

fibo_financial_instrument.name: name
fibo_financial_instrument.description: Full descriptive name of the instrument as used in prospectus or offering documents

fibo_financial_instrument.name: issuer_lei
fibo_financial_instrument.description: LEI of the issuing legal entity; references fibo_legal_entity.lei

fibo_financial_instrument.name: issue_date
fibo_financial_instrument.description: Date the instrument was first issued or listed

fibo_financial_instrument.name: maturity_date
fibo_financial_instrument.description: Contractual maturity or expiry date (NULL for perpetual instruments like equities)

fibo_financial_instrument.name: face_value
fibo_financial_instrument.description: Nominal/par value per unit in the denomination currency at issuance

fibo_market.name: mic
fibo_market.description: ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (4-char, e.g. XNAS, XLON, XPAR)

fibo_market.name: name
fibo_market.description: Full official name of the exchange or trading venue

fibo_market.name: country
fibo_market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the market is regulated

fibo_market.name: city
fibo_market.description: City where the exchange is headquartered or primarily operates

fibo_price.name: id
fibo_price.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key (BIGSERIAL for high-volume time-series data)

fibo_price.name: market_mic
fibo_price.description: Venue where the price was observed; references fibo_market.mic (ISO 10383)

fibo_price.name: price_type
fibo_price.description: Price observation type: OPEN, HIGH, LOW, CLOSE, BID, ASK, MID, VWAP, SETTLEMENT

fibo_price.name: price
fibo_price.description: Observed price value in the stated currency with 8 decimal places for precision

fibo_price.name: currency_code
fibo_price.description: ISO 4217 currency in which this price is quoted (may differ from instrument denomination)

fibo_price.name: price_date
fibo_price.description: Trading or settlement date for this price observation

fibo_price.name: volume
fibo_price.description: Number of units traded on price_date at this market (NULL for non-trade price types)

short_description: Financial Industry Business Ontology — EDM Council + OMG standard
long_description: FIBO (Financial Industry Business Ontology) is the EDM Council and OMG's comprehensive financial domain ontology covering 10,000+ concepts. This schema captures the most practically useful subset: legal entities with LEI codes, currencies, financial instruments (equities, bonds, derivatives), exchanges with MIC codes, and market data prices. All identifiers align with GLEIF, ISO 4217, and ISO 10383.
when_to_use: Use for financial data management platforms, instrument master data, or any system that must precisely model the relationships between issuers, instruments, markets, and prices. Required for SFDR, MiFID II, and EMIR reporting where entity and instrument identification must be unambiguous. Pairs with GLEIF for entity LEI validation.
